instruction: Save every inbox email as a separate plain text file in the ~/emails.txt.bak folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting inbox emails as .txt files instead of .eml files. The evaluator checks for the same email subjects as the original task but with .txt extension. Similar to original task in complexity - file export operation with regex pattern matching.
